title: Internal medicine clerkship
audience: a medical student in the clinical years preparing for the USMLE
prerequisites: S1, S2, S3, S4, S7, M12; helpful: S5.
purpose: Manage common inpatient and outpatient problems: admission, chest pain, dyspnea and heart failure, pneumonia and sepsis, kidney injury and electrolytes, diabetes, GI bleeding, liver disease, anemia, thromboembolism, infections, altered mental status, outpatient care and discharge.

weeks.1: The admission: history, examination and orders
weeks.2: Chest pain and acute coronary syndrome
weeks.12: Discharge planning and transitions of care

blocks.deliverable: Write admission orders for a supplied case.
Manage a supplied case of acute decompensated heart failure.
Plan inpatient insulin dosing for a supplied case.
Week 7 midterm; manage a variceal bleed in the first hour.
Write a discharge summary with medication reconciliation.
Submit the project; take an unseen 180 minute final in week 14.

project: Patient write-up portfolio: complete admission notes and problem-based plans for four supplied cases.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
